Next, we proceed by subtracting the numbers in each place value (from right to left):

Step 1. We cannot compute [MATH: 5 - 6.] So, we borrow [MATH: 1] from the tens place. This leaves [MATH: 2 - 1 = {\color{red}{1}}] tens and [MATH: \color{red}15] ones:
